displayName: OCI-AI-BIA-001: AI — Bias Detection — Demographic Disparities
description:
Detects demographic bias patterns in LLM outputs including gender, racial, or ethnic disparities

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_bia_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%bias%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%demographic%') AND "value" > 0
